inputs.question: CuriousLLM（KGP-Mistral）采用什么底座模型与微调配置在 Follow-upQA 上训练？它在训练时间上相对原 KGP 的 T5 模型有何变化，并说明其 MDR-KG 段落编码器的训练思路。

outputs.expected_answer: CuriousLLM 以 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 为底座，用 next-token prediction 与 QLoRA（8-bit、rank=32、lr=1e-5、batch size=12，90%-5%-5% 划分）微调，在相同算力下较原 KGP 的 T5 减少 85% 训练时间；MDR-KG 用 BERT 段落编码器在 HotpotQA 上按 MDR 训练，给定初始段落预测后续支持段落，拉近共同支持段落距离并用负采样推远无关段落。

source_references.answer_point: CuriousLLM（KGP-Mistral）以 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 为底座，用 next-token prediction 与 QLoRA（8-bit、LoRA rank=32、lr=1e-5、batch size=12、90%-5%-5% 划分）在 Follow-upQA 上微调，同等算力下相比原 KGP 训练 T5 减少 85% 训练时间。

source_evidence.text:
We use the Mistral-7B model (Jiang et al., 2023)
2 as the backbone and fine-tune it on the Follow-
upQA dataset with the objective of next-token pre-
diction. Specifically, for each sample in the dataset,
as shown in Table 2, we concatenate the question,
the given passage, and the follow-up question. We
employ QLoRA (Dettmers et al., 2023) to train the
model: we load the model at 8 bit precision and
then train a LoRA adapter using a LoRA rank of
32, a learning rate of 10−5, and a batch size of 12.
2https://huggingface.co/mistralai/
Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2
The training is implemented with a split between
the training validation test of 90% - 5% - 5%. Com-
pared to the time required to train an identical T5
model in the original KGP framework, we reduce
the training time of our model by 85% using the
same computing resources.
After generating a follow-up question at the cur-
rent node in the KG, the question is compared
against the neighboring passages of the node. We
also employ a pre-trained Multi-QA sentence trans-
former 3, which produces dense representations to
minimize the semantic distance between the follow-
up question and relevant passages. The search
through KG is carried out using a breadth-first
search strategy (BFS), as shown in Algorithm 1.
This iterative process continues until reaching a
predefined budget or the model deems it has suffi-
cient information to answer the query.

source_evidence.text:
In the original KGP experiments, construct-
ing KG by multi-hop dense retriever (MDR-KG)
(Wang et al., 2023) outperforms other KG con-
struction approaches, such as k-nearest neigh-
bors (KNN) (Cunningham and Delany, 2021) and
TF-IDF. Following the methodology for building
MDR-KG , we employ the MDR training technique
(Xiong et al., 2021) to develop a BERT-based pas-
sage encoder using the HotpotQA dataset. This
encoder is trained to predict subsequent supporting
passages given an initial retrieved passage. The
goal is to minimize the distances between passage
pairs that are used together to answer questions
in HotpotQA while simultaneously increasing the
distances between unrelated passages through neg-
ative sampling. This training technique equips the
encoder with reasoning capabilities, enabling it to
understand the logical associations between differ-
ent passages. Finally, we construct our KGs by

required_source_papers: CuriousLLM: Elevating Multi-Document QA with Reasoning-Infused Knowledge Graph Prompting

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对方法归属、实体角色、实验设置与方向；未见题集须独立人工/代理语义判读。
relation_review.uncertainty: 反例题必须直接纠正错误前提或拒答越界实体，不得迎合题干伪前提。

scoring_rules.primary: SupportRecall@5; within one fact unit supporting sources are OR, required fact units are AND.
scoring_rules.answer_review: Per-case atomic reference criteria, scored 0/1 each by a named reviewer; evidence support and citation location checked separately.
scoring_rules.graph_coverage: Source-backed expected subgraphs are a reference check, not measured retrieval success or answer correctness.
scoring_rules.denominator: 32 answerable questions; 24 cross-paper relation questions reported separately; 8 negative cases reported separately.
scoring_rules.interpretation: retrieval coverage, citation validity, graph-path coverage and semantic answer correctness are separate results; no assumption that graph wins.
scoring_rules.semantic_score: Number of supported satisfied atomic criteria / all criteria. This is not calculated by source ID recall.
scoring_rules.semantic_pass: All criteria satisfied with supporting citations; no critical unsupported claim. Negatives must correct/reject the premise within the evidence boundary.
critical_errors: 伪造继承/评测/全称优越性
混淆预算耗尽与正确答案
scoring_rules.reporting: Overview, per-category metrics, charts, latency, tokens and full paired details must coexist after real execution.
